svg.text: AFE Pod – Shaft, Gear Box, Generator and Power Route
AFE Pod – side and end elevations, and power route direction
TO VERTICAL BLADE UNIT – SEE DWG 1
INDICATIVE ARTIST'S ILLUSTRATION – NOT TO SCALE
Dimensions to be confirmed by survey and detailed design
Enclosure: aluminium sheet over marine ply on a welded steel base frame, 2 000 x 1 000 x 1 500 mm high. Sealed, ventilated, with a bolted access panel to one end.
Drive: the vertical shaft from the blade unit runs straight up into the gear box; the gear box output drives the generator through a flexible coupling.
Podular maintenance: 4 no. locking pins are withdrawn, the drive shaft is parted at its disconnect pin, and the whole pod lifts off on its four lifting eyes — see Drawing 10.
Pod envelope is as advised and is tight for a MW-class generator — to be checked against the selected gear box and generator frame sizes.
Power: each pod feeds a deck cable tray running to the landward end, then a riser to the shore switchgear shed for breakers, metering and transformation.
Vibration isolation, drainage, earthing and cathodic protection are not shown and are to be developed at detailed design.
